arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Harper argued deferred payments must equal the present value of collateral.
She stated present value is an objective concept involving real interest and inflation.
Mr. Brunstad argued the formula approach is inaccurate and under-values risks.
He cited a forty percent payment rate for Chapter 13 debtors as evidence of risk.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case concerns the calculation of deferred payments for secured debt in Chapter 13 bankruptcy. The dispute centers on the appropriate interest rate to apply to these payments.
